purpose: Teach: 有馬/松浦/コウ/シイ/コリア/ダスト/クローバー/チェア

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「有馬温泉に旅行しよう」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad mentioned wanting to take a trip to Arima hot springs.
lines.style: Warm, gentle voice settling into a memory. Soft pace, slightly distant—sharing something she overheard with quiet affection. Slight smile underneath.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと長崎県松浦市の海岸行ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I went to the coast in Matsuura with Dad!
lines.style: Bright, immediate excitement. Lean forward slightly in the delivery. Quick pace, words tumbling out. The pride of sharing something precious with someone who matters.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「コウくんと仲良くね」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad said to be kind to Kou, didn't he.
lines.style: Thoughtful, conversational tone. Pause slightly before the punchline—letting the observation breathe. Not correcting, just reflecting back what she heard.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとシイたけ狩りに行ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I went mushroom picking together!
lines.style: Unguarded joy. Voice opens up on the verb. Quick, genuine laugh underneath. The warmth of a small ritual shared and now being told.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「コリア、つまり韓国の文化は奥が深い」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was saying Korean culture runs very deep.
lines.style: Thoughtful cadence, like she's turning the idea over. Slower pace. Warmth without urgency—the tone of someone sharing something that stuck with her.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと「ダストの少ない部屋」掃除したよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I cleaned the room to get the dust out!
lines.style: Bright, unburdened delivery. Light rhythm on the accomplishment. Voice carries the quiet pride of work done together, matter-of-fact and warm.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「四つ葉のクローバーは幸運の象徴」って教えて下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad told me four-leaf clovers are a symbol of good luck.
lines.style: Gentle, almost wonder in the voice. Slower delivery. The tone of someone sharing something magical with someone young enough to believe it still is.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと公園のチェアでお茶飲んだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I had tea sitting on a bench in the park.
lines.style: Soft, contented voice. Unhurried pace—the memory itself is comfortable enough to linger in. Small, genuine pleasure in the ordinariness of it.
